title: Claude Code Rule Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter for .claude/rules/*.md guard files. REQUIRING `paths` is deliberately STRICTER than Claude Code, which loads a rule that omits it unconditionally, at the same priority as .claude/CLAUDE.md. That is legal and it is still wrong: an unscoped rule is charged to every session's context whether or not the work touches what it guards, which is the cost the always-loaded context budget exists to measure. A rule worth writing is a rule worth scoping. Paired with `additionalProperties: false` so a typo'd key (`path:`, `globs:`) fails loudly instead of silently downgrading the rule to always-loaded.

paths.description: Glob patterns, relative to the repo root, that trigger this rule when a matching file is read. At least one: an empty list scopes the rule to nothing, which is a rule that never fires rather than a rule that always does
